title: GeneralContact
author: JG
description: check difference of friction force computation of SphereSphereContact (see notes in .cpp file) and GeneralContact
releaseNotes: GeneralContact with an implicit solver keeps the sliding or sticking state of a friction contact that its active set gives during the Newton iteration, as ObjectContactSphereSphere does; a sliding ball agrees with the rigid-body solution (contactComparisonTest.py).
